purpose: Review official Yanji/Jilin land-registration and public-geospatial channels for an anonymous parcel geometry service with native identifiers.
assessment: Yanji has a municipal real-property registration/transaction portal, and the Jilin Natural Resources Department describes the city registration center and integrated digital service system. A published project award confirms an integrated registration/transaction management platform. These sources establish registry custody and operational infrastructure, but the reviewed materials do not document an anonymous parcel polygon service. The city homepage timed out on escalated anonymous access and the public Jilin Tianditu landing response contained no readable layer metadata. No exact WUP point query was run; no geometry absence or coverage claim is made.
registryAssessment: Official sources confirm Yanji property registration and property-information systems. They do not verify unrestricted, anonymous parcel-vector access.
